display_text: Upgradeable Item (Black Abbot) ** [[Light Resistance|Light Resistance +20]][[Light Resistance|Light Resistance +20]]: Passive: +20 [[Enhancement bonus]] to your Light Resistance.[[Category:Light Resistance +20 items]] → [[Light Resistance|Light Resistance +30]][[Light Resistance|Light Resistance +30]]: Passive: +30 [[Enhancement bonus]] to your Light Resistance.[[Category:Light Resistance +30 items]] ** Adds [[Spell_Augmentation|Lesser Arcane Augmentation IX]][[Spell_Augmentation|Lesser Arcane Augmentation IX]]: Increases the wearer's caster level when casting ninth level or lower sorcerer or wizard spells by one.[[Category:Lesser Arcane Augmentation IX items]][[Category:Upgradeable items]]
